name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Fair point on open standards. If the SC26 demos turn into design wins, networking becomes a steadier leg next to custom silicon. AVGO closed at $331.98, still below its 50-day average of $346.13, so this needs follow through, not just a good show.

Morgan Stanley still puts 72% upside on Broadcom in the middle of the AI-infra selloff, above even the Street's ~$530 average target. The distance from $332 says a lot about how fast sentiment turned, less about the order book. $AVGO
Burry 又盯上博通了。据 @burrytracker 转述，他翻 Anthropic 交易发现博通承诺供 1610 亿美元设备、还另有 420 亿美元“出借”，质疑这是拿越做越大的交易藏债务，表态不买下周的 IPO。另一边也有反驳：博通是成本加成、严格预收现金，不是供应商融资。这笔账 12 月 9 日财报前大概还得吵一阵。$AVGO

Design AI can speed up drawing a chip. It doesn't replace the rest of the stack: SerDes, networking, packaging, co-designing with the hyperscaler. Google's TPU is still built with Broadcom, not instead of it. Fabless was never just drawing chips.

Monday was rotation, not everything moving together. NVDA down while AVGO bounced says it plainly enough. One day doesn't make a trend though, and AVGO is still under its 20-day line. Divergence worth watching, nothing more yet.

Fair point. AMD getting the host slot doesn't change Broadcom's seat at the table. TPU 8tx is more a reshuffle of existing silicon than a new chip, and Broadcom is still the design and manufacturing partner on future generations. The networking side matters too.
谷歌第八代 TPU 一次出了两款：8tx 主攻机密推理，8i Max 主攻超大上下文。关键是这两款都是现有硅片重新配置，不算新芯片，瞄准的也是谷歌自己的推理负载。TPU 扩得越快，帮谷歌做芯片的博通受益越直接。周一 $AVGO 涨 8.8% 到 319.48 美元，不过还在 20 日均线下方，先当超跌反弹看。 https://t.co/iULTWDfzGA

Good data, but the concentration matters. $22.34M of the $23.67M was Brazeal, and all five sales were June-July, not recent weeks. Insider selling is a flag, not a verdict. AVGO closed Friday at $293.69, already well under its $332.12 20-day average.

If January brings subpoenas on the circular deals, the Broadcom–Anthropic arrangements will get a second look. The orders don't change, but the market would start pricing the financing structure, not just the backlog.

The custom silicon point is the interesting one here. If hyperscalers keep building their own ASICs, SerDes and packaging become the bottleneck, and that's right where Broadcom sits. Q4 AI guide around $21.7B backs up the demand side.
一边是 BofA 说数据中心支出今年破 1 万亿美元、2028 年到 2.1 万亿，博通 Q3 AI 收入 +221%、Q4 指引 217 亿；另一边是 Anthropic 担保敞口和 AI 支出能不能持续的质疑。$AVGO 跌破 300 美元，分歧就在这儿：增速没变，变的是市场愿意为什么买单。 https://t.co/19WFu0fmCi
